versions.content: Development error handling in context of Xcp_Trigger- Transmit Status: DRAFT Replaces: SWS_Xcp_00842 If development error detection for the XCP module is enabled: if the function Xcp_TriggerTransmit is called before the XCP was initialized successfully, the function Xcp_TriggerTransmit shall raise the development error XCP_E_UNINIT and return E_NOT_OK.
